name: The warning that went nowhere
summary: Automated warnings exist, but they are delivered to a channel nobody treats as an alert route, and nobody is watching it, so the failure is discovered during the disaster.
safe_pattern: Route every warning a change can raise to a channel with an active owner who is watching, before the change goes live.

conditions.text: The changed system sends automated warnings to a channel

citations.quote: an internal Knight Capital system generated 97 automated emails that went to a group of personnel.
While notifications are enabled for any cronjobs that error, these notifications are sent by email.

conditions.text: That channel is an email list, not an alert route

conditions.text: Nobody active is watching that channel

citations.quote: These messages were caused by the code deployment failure, but Knight Capital did not act upon them on August 1.
This means we were never aware of the backups failing, until it was too late.
Knight Capital incorrectly deployed new code in the same router.
